name: obx-node-ts
description: Open Brand Exchange node in TypeScript (Hono) for Cloudflare Workers and Bun

scripts.deploy: wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote

cloudflare.label: Open Brand Exchange · Portal for Cloudflare

OBX_SECRET_KEY.description: A long random string (at least 32 characters). It encrypts stored credentials and signs download links. Generate one with: openssl rand -base64 48

OBX_SETUP_CODE.description: A code you choose (6+ characters). You type it once in the setup wizard, so nobody else can claim your new node.
